purchased one of the over 79,000 seats at

play.Members of the AFC west,the Kansas City
Chiefs were founded by Lamar Hunt.The current
president of the NFL team is Carl Peterson,and
the head coach is Herman Edwards.In their
history as a team,the Kansas City Chiefs have
been to the playoffs 14 times in their career,but
have never made it to the Super Bowl.Yet they
do have a lot to make their fans proud and a
future ahead of them that has not been written
yet.Fans in Kansas and around the country are
not ready to give up hope for their favorite team,
and wear their Kansas City Chiefs jerseys as
proof of their commitment as fans.
